note: Rewritten from Ahmad's (1965) description of the new species; the original is in English. The material begins at TABLE 10 on p. 38 and covers the major soldier, the minor soldier, the comparison and the type locality; the worker and the alate fall outside the source range, hence no sections for those two castes. In TABLE 10 the holotype value of 2.28 for the head width at the posterior outer end of the antennal carinae lies below the lower limit of the range, 2.34; in TABLE 11 the morphotype column for head length to the base of the mandibles at the side of the head and for the width of the metanotum is blank in the OCR, and both are reproduced as they stand, not filled in. The original spells the type locality Mae Sod (now Mae Sot).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The major soldier resembles the soldiers of M. khajuriai Roonwal and Chhotani and of M. barneyi Light. It differs from M. khajuriai in the far sparser pilosity of the head, postmentum and pronotum, and in the postmentum contracting immediately behind its widest point (M. khajuriai has no waist). It differs from M. barneyi in that the pronotal lateral lobes of the latter are broader and more rounded and less projecting, and its third antennal segment is twice as long as the second (in the present species it is only slightly longer than the second). The minor soldier differs from M. khajuriai in the 17-segmented antenna (16 segments in M. khajuriai) and in the faintly contracted postmentum; in M. barneyi the third antennal segment is 1.5 times as long as the second and the thoracic nota are narrower. Type locality: beside the road to Tak, 20 km east of Mae Sod, Thailand; soldiers (holotype, paratype, morphotype, paramorphotype) and workers collected by M. Ahmad on 18 April 1962 (month 4) in a fallen log.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier (Fig. 33): head capsule pale reddish brown, slightly darker around the postclypeus and in the anterolateral corners of the head; labrum reddish brown, with a white, transparent tip; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; antennae brownish; thorax pale brown; abdominal tergites slightly paler than the thoracic nota. Cephalic pilosity extremely sparse; a few setae on the postclypeus and 2-3 more behind it; a row of setae on each side of the labrum; a few long setae and short hairs on the anterior part of the postmentum; a few short hairs on the anterior margin of the pronotum and one pair of setae on each side of the disc. Head nearly rectangular, convex in the middle in lateral view and slightly inclined forward; fontanelle minute, circular, situated near the middle of the head. Compound eyes small, dot-like. Labrum narrowed forward, widest in its posterior half, its tip broadly triangular. Mandibles short and stout, slightly curved at the tip; the inner margin of the left mandible finely serrate, with an inconspicuous tooth at the base; the right mandible unserrated, without a basal tooth. Postmentum long, slightly arched; the waist slightly below the widest point; the lateral margins of the posterior half weakly convex. Antennae 17-segmented; segments 2 and 3 subequal. Pronotum convex anteriorly with a median notch; lateral lobes projecting, narrowly rounded; posterior margin distinctly concave. Mesonotum much narrower than the pronotum; lateral lobes slightly angulate; posterior margin weakly concave in the middle. Metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum; sides broadly rounded; posterior margin nearly straight. Measurements (mm; holotype, range, mean): head length to the base of the mandibles at the side of the head 3.69 (3.27-3.74, 3.54); head width at the base of the mandibles 1.76 (1.74-1.97, 1.87); head width at the posterior outer end of the antennal carinae 2.28 (2.34-2.65, 2.51); maximum head width 2.75 (2.70-3.01, 2.88); left mandible length 1.56 (1.56-1.69, 1.63); postmentum length 2.08 (1.79-2.39, 2.10); maximum postmentum width 0.78 (0.78-0.88, 0.81); minimum postmentum width 0.62 (0.62-0.67, 0.64); pronotum length 0.88 (0.88-0.93, 0.90); pronotum width 1.82 (1.76-1.97, 1.83); mesonotal width 1.43 (1.40-1.50, 1.44); metanotal width 1.56 (1.56-1.66, 1.60). Minor soldier (Fig. 34): head capsule pale yellowish brown; postclypeus slightly darker than the head; labrum and antennae brown; mandibles reddish brown; thorax and abdominal tergites slightly paler than the head; legs yellow. Head with a few scattered setae; a row of long setae on each side of the labrum; a few scattered setae on the anterior part of the postmentum and a few microsetae on its basal third; a few microsetae on the anterior margin of the pronotum and scattered setae on the disc; a transverse row of setae on the mesonotum; setae on the metanotum arranged as on the mesonotum. Head narrowed forward, lateral margins convex; fontanelle minute, dot-like, slightly behind the middle. Compound eyes minute, whitish. Labrum long, ligulate, widest in its posterior half; tip transparent. Mandibles long and slender, slightly incurved at the tip; left mandible with several teeth at the base and unserrated over the rest of its inner margin; right mandible without serrations or teeth. Postmentum moderately arched, slightly more than twice as long as its maximum width; lateral margins nearly parallel; a faint waist. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 2 slightly longer than 3, segment 3 slightly shorter than 4. Pronotum slightly more than half as long as wide; anterior margin with an inconspicuous median notch; lateral lobes narrowly rounded; posterior margin weakly concave in the middle. Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, its posterior margin very shallowly concave in the middle. Metanotum distinctly wider than the mesonotum; posterior margin straight. Measurements (mm; morphotype, range, mean): head length to the base of the mandibles at the side of the head — (1.82-1.92, 1.87); head width at the base of the mandibles 0.88 (0.88-0.93, 0.90); head width at the posterior outer end of the antennal carinae 1.35 (1.32-1.40, 1.36); maximum head width 1.56 (1.56-1.63, 1.58); left mandible length 1.19 (1.09-1.19, 1.14); postmentum length 1.14 (1.09-1.14, 1.12); maximum postmentum width 0.46 (0.46, 0.46); minimum postmentum width 0.44 (0.41-0.46, 0.44); pronotum length 0.62 (0.62-0.65, 0.63); pronotum width 1.04 (1.04-1.09, 1.06); mesonotal width 0.80 (0.80-0.83, 0.81); metanotal width — (0.96-1.01, 0.99).
